summary: NN, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that on October 7, 2026 it redeemed all 18,400 remaining shares of its Series D Perpetual Preferred Stock for an aggregate cash Redemption Price of about $30.7 million, reflecting a $5.0 million reduction under an August 5, 2026 Exchange Agreement with holder NHTV Nevada Holdings LP. Following the final redemption, no Series D shares remain outstanding and the holder's rights, including under the March 22, 2021 Board Observer Agreement, terminated. No advisor, board recommendation, or premium was disclosed. Watch for liquidity impact and elimination of preferred dividends/dilution overhang.
